evidence: Nate Jackson (a host/star of the channel) has his own Netflix special 'Nate Jackson: Super Funny' (2025), was a cast member on MTV's Wild 'n Out, and stars in Peacock's The Paper.
The channel's flagship series 'Forbidden History' is also on its YouTube channel and has aired on Science Channel, Travel Channel and Discovery in the US.
The Pokémon anime that this channel streams (Indigo League, Horizons and others) airs on Netflix and TV Tokyo, and the Pokémon FAST channel launched on Pluto TV in October 2024.

Chronicle is a Little Dot Studios/History Hit channel. History Hit produced Channel 5 series such as The World's Greatest Discoveries with Dan Snow, and it also runs a History Hit FAST channel on Samsung TV Plus.
